paper_metadata.title: A Monolithic Current-Mode CMOS DC–DC Converter With On-Chip Current-Sensing Technique
paper_metadata.abstract: A monolithic current-mode CMOS DC–DC converter with integrated power switches and a novel on-chip current pulsewidth-modulation (PWM) control and current-limited sensor for feedback control is presented in this paper. With the pulse-frequency-modulation (PFM) control schemes are widely proposed accurate on-chip current sensor, the sensed inductor used in industries due to their fast dynamic response and aucurrent, combined with the internal ramp signal, can be used for tomatic over-current protection [2]–[4].
